question: By how much is 65% of 65 greater than (1)/(5)of 25?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First, calculate 65% of 65 by multiplying 65 × 0.65 = 42.25

Second, calculate 1/5 of 25 by dividing 25 ÷ 5 = 5

Subtract the two values to find how much greater it is: 42.25 − 5 = 37.25

**∴ The correct answer is 37.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First value = 65% of 65

Second value = 1/5 of 25

 Visual Comparison of the Values
 
 
 65% of 65 :
 42.25
 
 
 1/5 of 25 :
 5
 
 
• 
 

 Difference = 37.25

**Calculations:**

⇒ First value = (65 × 65) ÷ 100

⇒ First value = 4225 ÷ 100 = 42.25

⇒ Second value = 1/5 × 25

⇒ Second value = 25 ÷ 5 = 5

⇒ Difference = First value − Second value

⇒ Difference = 42.25 − 5 = 37.25

**∴ The correct answer is 37.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Squaring Numbers Ending in 5

For a number of the format n5, its square is given by multiplying n × (n + 1) and appending 25 at the end. Example: For 65, 6 × 7 = 42, so appending 25 gives 4225.

Percentage Commutativity

The rule states that a% of b = b% of a. In our case, computing 65% of 65 simplifies to finding (65 × 65) ÷ 100.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

Fractions can be converted to percentages for simpler mental math. For instance, 1/5 is equal to 20%. Therefore, finding 1/5 of 25 is perfectly equivalent to calculating 20% of 25.
